messages:
Marta G: FYI — running month-end accrual check, found an ~11.8% variance on deferred revenue for Dedicated prepay (Apr–Jun contracts).
Daniel K: do we have a quick root-cause? usage mismatch or recognition schedule change?
Marta G: initial look: two things — (1) a set of annual commits invoiced in March were recorded as 12-month deferral starting Mar 1, but contracts actually start Apr 15 (client requested delayed deploy) so ~1.2M revenue got pulled forward.
Ryan S: that would explain the bump. Did billing send the amendment? invoice id: INV-3689
Marta G: yes invoice shows Mar 3, amendment email on Apr 10. Billing didn't reclassify. attaching snippet:
```
INV-3689  | ACME Corp | $1,200,000 | Invoice_date: 2026-03-03 | Contract_start: 2026-04-15
```
Olivia P: for close: proposal = reverse March recognition and post deferral starting Apr 15; manual JE to adjust Mar P&L. Need CFO sign-off for out-of-period correction?
Daniel K: can we treat as an accounting estimate/processing error (materiality)? it's ~0.9% of monthly rev. tagging CFO for visibility.
Ryan S: also might be a bug: the rev-scheduler appears to default the schedule start to invoice_date if contract_start is missing in the billing payload. opening an eng ticket.
Marta G: opened ticket INC-4721 for rev-scheduler. tagging eng to triage. For month-end action: Olivia, can you prepare JE with reversing entry + deferral schedule (include GL impact by account)?
Olivia P: on it — will have draft JE and updated revenue schedule in 30m, will include a short memo for audit trail. cc @revops-bot to create review task.
revops-bot: New review task created: REVW-2026-04 — accrual variance review. Reviewer: Daniel K. Due: 2026-04-30.
Daniel K: I'll review Olivia's JE once posted. If clean, route to accounting for posting and note for Q2 disclosure if needed.
Marta G: thanks — follow-ups: (a) Billing to confirm amendment processing and update invoice posting rules, (b) Eng to fix scheduler default to prefer contract_start, (c) Finance ops to add a pre-close check that highlights invoice_date != contract_start.
Olivia P: adding checklist item to month-end playbook and creating a short how-to for JEs. :white_check_mark:
Marta G: closing loop — once JE is posted, I'll rerun recognition reconciliation and confirm variance drops back in line for the close report.
